title: Formalizing the Reduced Mahler 3/2 Dynamical System in Lean 4: Exact 1D Slack Reduction, Constructive Coasting Survivors, Conditional Finiteness Theorems, and Certified Transcendence Barriers
description: A 140-file, sorry-free Lean 4.19.0 + Mathlib v4.19.0 formalization of the reduced Mahler 3/2 dynamical system (Z-numbers), developed by Joshua Coon with Astra and Argon AI assistance via GitHub Copilot. Proves the exact 1D minSlack dynamical reduction, the 5-way general Mahler conjecture equivalence with signed integer margin failure on positive stabilized seed branches and unbounded growth of least surviving positive seeds B(N), certified global lower bound B(29) >= 4096, unconditional exclusions of arbitrary two-letter mechanical/Sturmian chains, sub-critical liminf-complexity chains (kappa < log(2)/log(3/2)) under global, uniform-window, or scale-local balance (including non-stationary oscillating-epoch words), Thue-Morse and Period-Doubling encodings, rapid-growth odd-quotient descent, the 113-step survival and 114-step death of the 55-bit seed 29871555608238677, and certified Diophantine barrier analyses.
